paper_title: Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter in the Mass Range 41--74 $μ\mathrm{eV}$ using Millimeter-Wave Receiver and Radioshielding Box
notes: Paper sets upper limits chi < (0.5-3.9)e-10 at 95% CL over mass range 41-74 ueV (10-18 GHz). Detailed per-frequency limits are only shown in Fig. 11 (not numerically tabulated); only the overall range (0.5-3.9)e-10 is given in text. Encoded as a two-point line at the worst-case bound 3.9e-10 spanning the mass range; the best limit reaches 0.5e-10.
